titles.title: A Wicked Woman's Life With Her In-Laws Is Fun
The Villainess’s Married Life is Fun

description:
Esika endured life with her in-laws, relying solely on love.
However, as her husband commits adultery with his friend and suffers a major accident, she recalls memories of her past life.

She discovers that she was none other than the villainess Cheon Yeong-ryeong, and that this place is a world inside a book.

Recalling her past life and the ill-fated ties she shared with those who tormented her, Esika eventually vows revenge against the Duke's family.
